text: Heading somewhere crowded this weekend? Here's where your cards should go.
Saturday morning, and the market is packed. People shoulder to shoulder, a coffee in one hand, a bag of oranges in the other.
In a crowd like this, an open top or an outside pocket is the last place you want your cards and your passport.
So they go in the hidden pocket on the back. It zips shut and sits flat against you, so your passport and cards stay right there.
Your keys and phone ride in the two gold side zips, one on each side. One pull, and they're in your hand, without opening the bag.
Inside, the divided compartments keep everything else in its place, so nothing sinks to the bottom while you squeeze past the stalls.
You get through the whole market, bag zipped, cards against you, and both hands still free for the coffee.
